checks.explanation: Trump did not declare the Iran war over before his China trip. Instead, the trip itself was delayed by about seven weeks specifically because of the ongoing conflict (from late March to May 14-15), and by the time Trump landed in China the war still had not been resolved - reporting described him returning with 'no grand bargain' and no breakthrough on Iran.

checks.explanation: As of this validation, no Chinese attack on Taiwan has occurred, consistent with Allison's low-probability estimate, and this is corroborated by the US intelligence community's 2026 Annual Threat Assessment (China not currently planning a 2027 invasion) and prediction markets (Polymarket implying roughly 4% probability of invasion by end of 2026). However, Allison's stated window runs through 2027, which has not yet elapsed, so this cannot be fully evaluated yet.
